body:
Hi all and please excuse my ignorance:

I painted a mask over a beautiful bird sitting on an branch.
I used some fine contrast to be applied only to this masked bird - it works as expected.

**My question:**

Now I want to reuse this same mask elsewhere ... but I don't see / find a way how to refer to it. How can I achieve the intended reuse?

**_NB:_** I used to use _darktable_ for years but find it's GUI and tools behaviour much less than comfortable. Thus I currently investigate **ART** .... having already left _RawTherapee_ behind due to the lack of advanced selective retouching options.
title: ART newbie: How to reuse the same mask I painted in one tool in one or more other tools?
